adaptation.temporary_head: Linear(1024,4), on raw comment mean (before L2); FP32 logits
adaptation.final_embedding: comment mean, then L2 normalization, identical to A_mean
adaptation.optimizer: AdamW, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8; linear warmup and linear decay
adaptation.checkpoint_selection: highest validation temporary-head macro-F1; first checkpoint wins ties; no untrained epoch0 eligibility

input: identical full A classification chat; empty thinking template retained
pooling: arithmetic mean of final-layer comment-only token hidden states
dtype: BF16 base + FP32 trainable LoRA/temporary head, autocast BF16 transformer
main_comparison: B_mean frozen adapted encoder + independent MLP versus A_mean + same independent MLP
temporary_head_test: diagnostic only, scored after all checkpoints/MLPs fixed; never used as final B
seed_scope: Each B seed independently initializes LoRA, temporary head, training shuffle and final MLP; A varies final MLP only.
test_reuse: Exploratory, previously inspected test set. No test-driven hyperparameter changes.
